visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a light green V-neck top, stands in what appears to be a medical clinic. She is looking at the camera and gesturing while holding a red thermal cup. In the background, there are blurred medical posters and clinic logos. (2) The scene shifts to a slightly different indoor area with a wall of wooden lockers. The woman continues to talk energetically, using her free hand to emphasize her points. The lighting is bright and even. (3) A close-up shot shows a medical procedure in progress. A white mechanical device (CureJet) is being applied to a person's cheek near the eye. The patient is wearing dark eye protection. A gloved hand holds the device. (4) The woman is back in front of the lockers, looking relieved and prayerful. A map overlay of Asia briefly appears with an icon of her head moving from Taiwan to Korea. (5) She places her hand on her chest and looks upward as if in a humorous state of prayer, still holding the red cup. (6) A final static screen appears with the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo, contact phone numbers, and social media handles over a white marble-like background texture.
